tool_description: Save one visible user and assistant conversation pair as an Episodic Memory. Use the selected visible user message as input_text and the corresponding complete visible assistant answer as output_text without summarizing, rewriting, or substituting hidden reasoning or internal tool traffic.

Generate a short human-readable episode_title and a separate semantic episode_description from the selected pair. The description must summarize the episode's useful meaning well enough for later intelligent retrieval.

When the user explicitly supplies a Recall Key, pass that key exactly. When the user asks to save without supplying a key, generate a concise descriptive Recall Key yourself. Never use M1 through M100 because those names are reserved for Clipboard Memory.

GHOST checks owner-scoped Recall Keys in SQLite and may add _1, _2, and later numeric suffixes. Treat the Recall Key returned in the successful receipt as the actual stored key. One call saves one conversation pair.
server_instruction: When the user asks to save a normal memory episode, call ghost_memory_tag with the complete selected visible user and assistant pair, a generated Episode Title, a generated Episode Description, and a Recall Key.

Use the user's Recall Key exactly when provided; otherwise generate an appropriate descriptive key. After the call, claim success only when saved is true and workflow_state is complete. Report the returned Episode Title, actual Recall Key, and Record ID. If saved is false, state that the memory was not saved and report the sanitized reason.

field_descriptions.recall_key: The exact user-provided Recall Key, or a concise descriptive Recall Key generated by the client when the user omitted one. M1 through M100 are reserved.
field_descriptions.episode_title: A short human-readable title generated from the selected visible episode, preferably three to ten words.
field_descriptions.episode_description: A compact semantic description generated from the selected visible episode for later embedding and intelligent retrieval. It must be meaningfully different from a mere title.
field_descriptions.input_text: The complete selected visible user message, copied without summarization or rewriting.
field_descriptions.output_text: The complete corresponding visible assistant answer, copied without summarization or rewriting.
